name: Forafric Global PLC
summary: Forafric Global PLC engages in the purchase, storage, transport, processing, and sale of agricultural commodities and commodity products in Morocco and West Africa. It operates through Soft Wheat, Durum Wheat, and Couscous and Pasta segments. The company provides wheat flours and semolina; and secondary processing products, such as pasta and couscous. It operates under the TRIA and MayMouna brand names. The company serves wholesale foods manufacturers and distributors. It also exports its products to approximately 45 countries. Forafric Global PLC was founded in 1926 and is headquartered in Gibraltar.
